Setting.TrackGMHint: Include rolls made by the GM account in the statistics.
Setting.AutoStartHint: Automatically start a live session when a roll occurs and none is active.
Setting.AutoEndHint: End and archive the live session when fewer than two people are connected. Sessions also only auto-start when at least two people are connected.
Setting.AutoEndGraceHint: Wait this long before ending, so a page refresh or reconnect doesn't end the session.
Setting.Announce: Announce streaks and awards in chat
Setting.AnnounceHint: Post crit, fumble, hot and cold streaks and new award leaders to chat as they happen.
Setting.AnnounceDelayHint: Pause after a roll appears (after Dice So Nice finishes animating it) before streak and award messages are posted.
Setting.PostAwardsHint: Post an award summary to chat when the GM ends a session.
Setting.PlayerAccessHint: If disabled, only the GM can open the Dice Chronicle.
Setting.MinD20Hint: A player needs this many d20 rolls in a session to qualify for the luck awards (doubled for campaign totals).
Setting.OpenHint: Open the roll history, statistics and awards. Also available via Alt+J or the token controls.
